clues: This city sits where two clear streams join as one. It lies in south Colorado, a long way south of Denver.
In its warm belt, snow falls less here than in nearby towns. The dry land gets just twelve inches of rain and snow a year.
A huge flood tore through this town in nineteen twenty-one. It hurt the town so much that folks still teach its tale.
Walk by the river and you can learn the flood tale step by step. A long river walk was built to share that past.
Few towns in the land make as much steel as this one. That is why folks call it the Steel City.
